post.description:
Register a slide-deck generation job and return its initial status.

Returns immediately (HTTP 202) with state="pending" and a job_id.
The pipeline runs on an asyncio.Task in the background; clients poll
GET /jobs/{id} for state transitions and GET /jobs/{id}/pptx for the
binary once state="done".

get.description: Cheap polling endpoint. Returns the current JobStatus or 404.

delete.description: Cancel an in-flight job. No-op if already terminal.

get.description:
Stream the rendered .pptx for a completed job.

Returns 404 for unknown/cross-user jobs, 409 if the job is still
running, and 410 if it has been failed/cancelled.

post.description:
Register a report generation job and return its initial status.

Returns 202 with state="pending" and a job_id. The pipeline runs in
an asyncio.Task. The client polls GET /jobs/{id} until state="done"
then downloads any of the three formats.

Collection auth is validated synchronously up-front so the user gets
a 403/404 immediately on bad input, not as a delayed "failed" job.

get.description:
Cheap polling endpoint. Returns the current status or 404.

404 covers both "doesn't exist" and "exists but belongs to someone
else" — never leak cross-user existence.

delete.description:
Cancel an in-flight report job. No-op if already terminal.

Returns 204 on success or already-terminal; 404 if the job doesn't
belong to the caller (or never existed).

get.description:
Stream the rendered artifact for a completed job.

State semantics mirror the slides endpoint:
  - 404: unknown id / not yours
  - 409: still pending or running
  - 410: failed or cancelled
  - 200: streams the file from ``{ARTIFACTS_DIR}/{job_id}.{fmt}``

The actual bytes live on disk (reports are too big to keep in-RAM
like the slide pptx_bytes — a typical PDF can hit several MB).

post.description:
Register a mindmap-generation job and return its initial status.

Returns immediately (HTTP 202) with state="pending" and a job_id.
The pipeline runs on an asyncio.Task in the background; clients poll
GET /jobs/{id} for state transitions and GET /jobs/{id}/download/svg
once state="done".

get.description: Cheap polling endpoint. Returns the current MindmapJobStatus or 404.

delete.description: Cancel an in-flight job. No-op if already terminal.

get.description:
Stream the rendered SVG or DOT source for a completed job.

Returns 404 for unknown/cross-user jobs, 409 if still running, and
410 if the job is failed/cancelled.

200.description: Generated mindmap (SVG primary, DOT for debug)

post.description: Register an infographic-generation job, return 202 immediately.

delete.description: Cancel + delete a job, best-effort removing the artifact files.

get.description:
Stream the HTML or PDF artifact for a completed job.

Returns 404 for unknown/cross-user jobs, 409 if still running,
410 if failed/cancelled, 400 for unknown ``fmt``.

post.description:
Register a datatable job and return its initial status.

Authorises the collection access up-front (same pattern as slides)
so the client gets a synchronous 403/404 instead of an opaque
"failed" job seconds later.

get.description:
Polling endpoint — returns the current DatatableJobStatus or 404.

Cross-user access returns 404 (NOT 403) so the existence of a job
doesn't leak via status code differentiation.

delete.description:
Cancel an in-flight datatable job, or delete a terminal one.

Semantics match slides: 204 on success even if the job was already
terminal (frontend deletes its own row regardless). 404 only when
the job doesn't exist or belongs to someone else.

get.description:
Serve one of the three exported artifact formats.

fmt ∈ {html, csv, xlsx}.

Status codes:
  404 - job missing / not yours / fmt unknown / file gone from disk
  409 - job still running (artifacts not yet exported)
  410 - job failed or cancelled

Liveness + readiness gate.

``revocation_cache.ready`` flips to False if Redis disconnects; the
/health endpoint reports 503 in that window so k8s readiness probes
pull the pod out of the load balancer until it recovers.

jwks_client does not expose ``ready`` directly (it has a fallback
to lazy-fetch on first verify) but its cold-start happens in lifespan
so by the time we serve traffic it has at least one key cached.

DatatableJobStatus.title: DatatableJobStatus
DatatableJobStatus.description: Polling response for a datatable job. JSON body — no header buffer issues.

DatatablePreset.title: DatatablePreset
DatatablePreset.description:
Closed set of datatable presets the LLM picks layout / column-shape from.

String-valued enum so it serialises into JobStatus JSON cleanly and the
frontend can switch on the literal string (no need to mirror Python).

seed_query.title: Seed Query
seed_query.description: Optional retrieval seed. When omitted the runner builds one from `collection.name + preset + extra_instructions`.

document_ids.title: Document Ids
document_ids.description: Restrict retrieval to these documents only. None = whole collection. Empty list is rejected by csp.

target_columns.title: Target Columns
target_columns.description: Hints to the LLM about which columns the user wants. Free-form 繁中 strings (e.g. ['品名', '價格', '原產地']). LLM may still add / rename based on chunk content.

GenerateInfographicRequest.title: GenerateInfographicRequest
GenerateInfographicRequest.description:
``POST /api/infographics/jobs`` 入參。

Mirrors GenerateSpecRequest（slide pipeline）— collection_id 是
csp ingestion collection 的 PK；同一個 user 用同一個 bearer 鑑權。

GenerateMindmapRequest.title: GenerateMindmapRequest
GenerateMindmapRequest.description:
POST body for ``POST /api/mindmaps/jobs``.

All retrieval knobs are bounded (max_depth ≤ 5, top_k ≤ 20) so a
malicious or runaway caller can't force unbounded LLM context. The
defaults (depth=3, k=8) hit the sweet spot we observed in the
Studio slides pipeline: enough chunks for the LLM to write
specifically, not so many the prompt budget blows up.

extra_instructions.title: Extra Instructions
extra_instructions.description: user-supplied extra hints to flavour the report

document_ids.title: Document Ids
document_ids.description: optional list to restrict retrieval to specific docs

theme_override.title: Theme Override
theme_override.description: If set, bypasses LLM theme selection and forces this theme. Useful when the user knows the audience better than the LLM. Must be one of THEMES; invalid values rejected by Literal.

InfographicJobStatus.title: InfographicJobStatus
InfographicJobStatus.description: Polling 用 status payload — slide JobStatus 的鏡像版。

InfographicPreset.title: InfographicPreset
InfographicPreset.description:
四個 preset，對應前端 Studio CommandModal 上的快選按鈕。

Renderer 端用 preset 決定要不要展開特定 section（例：timeline_overview
若收到空 timeline，會把 stats grid 拉滿補位）。每個 preset 仍會渲染
所有有資料的 section — preset 只決定 "視覺重心"，不是 hard gate。

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Polling response for a Studio job. Body is JSON, header-buffer-safe.

MindmapJobStatus.title: MindmapJobStatus
MindmapJobStatus.description:
Polling response for ``GET /api/mindmaps/jobs/{job_id}``.

Body is JSON, header-buffer-safe. ``download_urls`` is populated on
state=done and keys vary by what got produced — at minimum
``"svg"``; ``"dot"`` is included for debug downloads (the DOT source
helps users tweak the graph offline).

MindmapPreset.title: MindmapPreset
MindmapPreset.description:
The shape of mindmap the user wants.

Values are stable strings — the renderer's preset → fill-colour
mapping and the LLM system prompt's "shape hint" both switch on
these values, so changing them is a breaking change.

download_urls.title: Download Urls
download_urls.description: {'html': ..., 'pdf': ..., 'docx': ...} — relative API paths, not absolute URLs. Frontend axios prepends its base URL.

ReportJobStatus.title: ReportJobStatus
ReportJobStatus.description:
Response shape for POST /jobs (202) and GET /jobs/{id}.

Mirrors ``app.schemas.studio.JobStatus`` but with report-specific
fields (preset, sections_count, references_count, download_urls).
Slide-specific fields (defects, qa_passes, slide_count) are not here.

ReportPreset.title: ReportPreset
ReportPreset.description:
The 4 supported report presets.

Each preset maps to:
- a Jinja2 template variant (different typography / colour / spacing),
- a different LLM prompt voice (formal academic / executive / tutorial /
  enterprise),
- a different default section structure hint.

Adding a new preset is a 3-line change: add the enum, add the template,
add the prompt voice in ``report_runner``.

VisualDefect.title: VisualDefect
VisualDefect.description: One issue spotted by the vision QA pass on a rendered slide.
